text: 以“共织算力网 智启新未来”为主题的2026中国算力大会在河北廊坊开幕。工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红在开幕式上致辞。 钟志红表示，算力已成为数智时代不可或缺的新型信息基础设施。“十五五”规划纲要明确提出，构建多层次算力设施体系和全国一体化算力网。为深入推进算力高质量发展，服务国家重大战略和经济社会发展需要，在此，提四点建议。 一是强化系统谋划，提升算力利用效能。推进算力设施有序建设，加快构建枢纽、区域、边缘多层次梯次化算力架构，持续完善中国算力平台功能，促进算力资源统筹监测和高效利用。
text_en: The 2026 China Computing Conference, themed "Weaving the Computing Power Network Together to Wisely Open a New Future," opened in Langfang, Hebei. Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Chief Engineer Zhong Zhihong delivered a speech at the opening ceremony. Zhong Zhihong said that computing power has become an indispensable new type of information infrastructure in the digital intelligence era. The outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan clearly proposes building a multi-tier computing power facility system and a nationwide integrated computing power network. To further advance the high-quality development of computing power and serve the needs of major national strategies and economic and social development, he put forward four suggestions here. First, strengthen systematic planning and improve the efficiency of computing power utilization. Promote the orderly construction of computing power facilities, accelerate the building of a hub, regional, and edge multi-tier and tiered computing power architecture, continuously improve the functions of China's computing power platform, and promote coordinated monitoring and efficient utilization of computing power resources.
